text:
Samir: Quick ask — Meridian wants a short, focused perf validation next Thurs. Targets: steady 210 qps, p50 < 80ms, p99 < 320ms. They also want two short spike tests (900 qps for 30s) and a regional failover check (us-east -> eu-west) with recovery under 90s. Deliverable: one-slide summary + CSV of raw metrics and a short note for their security questionnaire about logs/PII. Can eng take this and give a back-of-envelope delta for Dedicated 5xA10G vs hybrid (3xcommit + bursts)?

Eve: I can run it. Clarify model and typical token sizes? Will we test cold-starts or just warm cluster?

Samir: Model: open-stream-7b-quant. Typical prompt ~160 tokens, gen ~50 tokens. They care about both warm steady-state and one cold-start failover (to eu-west) so include image pull + model init in one of the tests.

Hector: Short plan:
- Provision primary cluster in us-east-1 (5xA10G) and warm standby in eu-west-1 (2xA10G)
- Warm sequences: run prefix-warm for 10-20m before steady tests
- Steady: 210 qps for 90m (collect p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, GPU util)
- Spikes: spawn 900 qps for 30s at t+20m and t+50m
- Failover: at t+75m cut traffic to eu-west, measure time-to-recover and tail behaviour (include cold-start case with image pull)

Use internal harness; example stub below:
```
./pbench --url https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \ 
  --payload meridian_template.json --qps 210 --duration 90m
# for spike: --qps 900 --duration 30s
```

Eve: Expected behavior notes:
- Steady 210 qps should get good batching; p50 likely ~60-80ms on A10G quant.
- Spikes will cause queueing; if queue_len tops > 180 we should add +1 GPU or increase max_batch_size.
- Cold failover will include image/model init + cache warm; without warm standby recovery will likely exceed 90s.

Samir: Commercial ask: rough delta so sales can discuss price sensitivity in the deal thread. A quick note is fine.

Hector: Ballpark (very rough): Dedicated 5xA10G commit ~ "$92k/mo" (incl platform fee). Hybrid (3xcommit + bursts to meet spikes) typically costs ~15-28% more on busy months depending on burst frequency. I'll refine after we measure tokens/sec/GPU in steady run.

infra-bot:  Provisioning: meridian-use1-5gpu and meridian-euw1-warm2gpu created. Loadgen nodes up. Model image: open-stream-7b-quant:v1. Warm scripts staged.

Eve: Ops checklist for the sprint:
- Start prefix-warm at T-20m
- Run 90m steady window and interleave two 30s spikes as scheduled
- Capture traces, export CSV of per-request latencies and tokens, and record GPU metrics (util, mem, queue_len)
- Push perf dashboard link + one-slide summary to this thread

legal-bot: Pasteable security blurb for questionnaire: "By default, user request payloads are redacted at the edge; operational logs retain anonymized request IDs, routing metadata, model ID, and performance metrics. Engineers do not have access to raw request bodies unless explicitly provisioned under a contractual agreement; such access is audited. Default retention: metrics 30 days, request traces 7 days. For strict data separation, Private deployment with customer-managed KMS and isolated audit sinks is available."

Samir: Timeline: Eve will run a smoke tonight, full run Thurs 02:00-06:00 UTC. Eve, drop raw CSV + brief slide (one page) and the perf dashboard link here after the run. Hector, can you also include a tiny table mapping observed tokens/sec per GPU -> monthly projected spend under both commit and hybrid? That’s what commercial needs.

Hector: Yep will include tokens/sec mapping row in the slide + CSV. Expected deliverable: slide + CSV + perf dashboard by Thurs EOD.

Eve: Running smoke now. Will post artifacts after the main run.

Samir: Thanks team. Keep messages short in this thread and tag me if anything blocks. :rocket:
